## What landed

- `web/src/lib/entity-figures.ts` — the page-owner composition: the merged
  twin → `sig.figure-kit-graph/1` (ego), `sig.figure-kit-chart/1`
  (timeline), `sig.figure-kit-geo/1` (map). Field mappings are declared in
  code and pinned by tests: kind → node kind (`org` → the honest generic
  `entity`, never a `vendor` claim), the three access kinds one-to-one
  (SIG-UI-024), `observed` → `single` date kind, `UNDATED` currency → the
  `aging` token with `date_kind: "undated"` carrying the truth (the kit's
  currency vocabulary has no undated state). Every node links: paged
  counterparty → its `/entity/` page; page-less counterparty → this page
  (root-relative per the kit's node-href contract — the page's relationship
  table + `#claim-` anchors are the evidence path, SIG-UI-122). Neighbour
  overflow declares `group_*` fields on every node — group, never silently
  prune (K6 §6.2). The timeline composes only `observed` dates; undated
  items are LISTED, never placed on the axis. The map spec renders only
  when `place_jkey` is recorded — else `null` → the typed "location not
  recorded" posture. `assertInlineSvgSafe` re-verifies the serializer's
  banned-markup contract at the serving seam (defence in depth).
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/[key]/[fig].svg.ts` — the figure endpoint:
  serves the kit-emitted SVG as a standalone document (`image/svg+xml`),
  bytes re-checked at the seam. The served document keeps every drawn node
  an `<a href>` (K2 row 7); the page presents it via `<img>` (see fix arc).
- `web/src/components/entity/EntityFigure.astro` — the ONE renderer every
  entity figure goes through: `<img>` wrapped in the open-document link,
  the caption, the generated legend (plain-English lines from the kit's
  meta), the table twin in a details block, and the typed not-emitted state
  (EF-01) when a record wave carries no figure.
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/[key]/index.astro` — the three new §4.2
  sections (recorded-relationships figure, timeline, recorded place) after
  the access section, plus the Print action when a twin exists; the
  explorer affordance is a named-absence sentence, never a dead `/explore/`
  route (K13 R-6).
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/[key]/print.astro` — the T0 print document
  (ADR-155 `…/print/` classification): standalone zero-script page — brief,
  figures, full relationship tables, cite + technical details — every
  `.sig-print-page` carries the running head/foot (entity label, release,
  permalink, page n of N); full favicon set + T0 social card (SIG-UI-154).
  Minted only for twin-bearing entities.
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getEntityFigures`/`getEntityFigureBytes`: the
  fixture/export seam (`web/src/fixtures/entity-figures/<type>/<key>/` vs

- `web/scripts/emit-entity-figures.ts` + `npm run fixture:entity-figures` —

- Committed fixture artifacts: `web/src/fixtures/entity-figures/agency/
  acworth-police-department--4g2wm8q/{ego,timeline,map}.{spec.json,svg,

- `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-06.md` — EF-01…03 rows (pending).
- `CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` — the public-behaviour entry.
- Tests: `web/tests/unit/entity-figures.test.ts` (14: mappings, spec pins

## Fix arc

1. `13927fb0` landed the companions with the kit SVG inlined via `set:html`.
2. e2e surfaced three sweep reds: axe `nested-interactive` +
   `no-focusable-content` on the inline SVG `<a>` nodes (WCAG 2.2 AA is
   enforced, not aspirational); the K14 NEW-7 glue check reading `</a><a`
   boundaries inside the inlined bytes; and the brand sweeps flagging the
   print page's missing favicon set + T0 social card.
3. `7f421fb0` re-architected: figures serve as standalone SVG documents at
   `entity/<type>/<key>/<kind>.svg` (the `<a href>` semantics stay in the
   opened document — C-08 posture) and the page renders `<img>`; print head
   gained the full favicon set + OG/Twitter card block. All sweeps green.
4. `check-root-absolute-paths` containment flagged root-absolute literals
   in `entity-figures.ts` → construction routed through the pinned
   `withBase()` seam + a computed-slash check (P36.41 precedent).
5. `docs` CI red on `20831d92` — two appended PHASE LOG entries carried
   unsanctioned kinds (`make-check record`/`pre-push record` ∉
   `phase_log_kinds.txt` → kind-vocabulary + verify-recorded-ci
   no-ci-field). In-place repair to the `correction` kind (NON_CI,
   truthful — they recorded the orient repair) with pre-edit bytes
   archived `reports/memory-repair/LEDGER_L1411_L1412_pre-P36.42b-kindfix.txt`
   + `seed-commit 849a0ef1` declared in `history.policy`.
6. `web` CI red on `b40ccaa9` — `/sources/` LCP 1510 ms vs the 1500 bound:
   `EntityFigure`'s scoped `<style>` emitted a shared
   `EntityFigure.*.css` chunk linked by every page (~0.65 KiB extra
   request + parse). Rewritten to emit zero CSS — the shared
   `.sig-figure-frame` (map.astro's class: max-width, border, print
   break-inside), `.sig-fig-caption` and `.sig-fig-legend` cover every
   rule; `/sources/` links its pre-existing assets only.
